headline.purpose: The day title and the screen titles of Pages, Tasks, the Calendar and sign-in. One per screen.

title.purpose: List headers and the Calendar's day headers.

section.purpose: The headings on a day page (TODO, Events, Good Stuffs, Notes) and review groups.

body.purpose: Every line the user writes, card titles, field text. The 700 px column is about 70 characters.

row.purpose: Rows inside the editor and page-card titles; a fixed 24 px line keeps a row level with its icon.

ui.purpose: Buttons, filter chips, sidebar rows, menu items.

small.purpose: Small sidebar rows, editor bar buttons, form labels.

meta.purpose: Badges, date chips, save state, hints, card metadata.

caption.purpose: Sidebar and menu group labels (uppercase, 0.05em) and shortcut hints.

shadows.name: float
shadows.purpose: Menus, the sheet, the phone's tab capsule and +, the floating capture bar, the selection bar, dialogs. A shadow means the layer floats above the page.

shadows.name: card-soft
shadows.purpose: A saved link card or a receipt: something brought in from outside the page.

motion.name: dur-fast
motion.purpose: Background, colour and opacity transitions on controls; the checkbox tick scaling in.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: The default easing for state transitions; 150ms for chevrons and the editor's block background.

motion.name: sheet-in
motion.value: translateY(24px) to 0 with opacity 0 to 1, 200ms ease-out
motion.purpose: A sheet sliding up; none under prefers-reduced-motion.

motion.name: block-flash
motion.purpose: A line that just moved; reduced motion shows the wash without animating.

breakpoints.name: chips-tight
breakpoints.purpose: Filter chips tighten so four fit a 375 px phone.

breakpoints.name: phone-small
breakpoints.purpose: The day's first arrow hides; sign-in top padding shrinks.

breakpoints.name: editor
breakpoints.purpose: Editor gutters; the sheet becomes a centred 560 px dialog above it.

breakpoints.name: laptop
breakpoints.purpose: The sidebar appears, the tab capsule goes, screens gain 48 px top padding, the capture bar floats under the title.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one forward action on a screen: Done, Sign in, Create page. The darkest grey, never blue; white on dark.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 14px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: var(--radius-control, 8px); background: var(--gray-12, #202020); color: var(--gray-1, #ffffff); font: 600 15px/1.3 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Text', 'PingFang SC', 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color .12s ease, color .12s ease, opacity .12s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover:not(:disabled) { background: var(--gray-11, #646464); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--blue-9, #0090ff); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: .4; cursor: default; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Today, Not today, Restore, Add, the day's arrows: white with a 1 px grey edge.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 14px; border: 1px solid var(--gray-7, #cecece); border-radius: var(--radius-control, 8px); background: var(--gray-1, #ffffff); color: var(--gray-12, #202020); font: 500 15px/1.3 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Text', 'PingFang SC', 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color .12s ease, color .12s ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover:not(:disabled) { background: var(--gray-2, #f9f9f9); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--blue-9, #0090ff); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-secondary:disabled { opacity: .4; cursor: default; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Arrows, the row's ⋯, Later: no edge, soft ink, a fill only on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 14px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: var(--radius-control, 8px); background: none; color: var(--gray-11, #646464); font: 500 15px/1.3 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Text', 'PingFang SC', 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color .12s ease, color .12s ease; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: var(--gray-3, #f0f0f0); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--blue-9, #0090ff); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Filter Chip
components.description: Tasks' lists and the Calendar's Earlier / Later. Selected is one step darker grey, never blue.
components.html: UpcomingTodayPaused
components.css: .ds-chips { display: flex; gap: 8px; } .ds-chip { flex: none; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; min-height: 40px; padding: 0 14px; border-radius: var(--radius-control, 8px); background: var(--gray-1, #ffffff); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--gray-6, #d9d9d9); color: var(--gray-11, #646464); text-decoration: none; font: 500 15px/1.3 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Text', 'PingFang SC', 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background-color .12s ease; } .ds-chip:hover { background: var(--gray-2, #f9f9f9); } .ds-chip[aria-current='page'] { background: var(--gray-3, #f0f0f0); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--gray-7, #cecece); color: var(--gray-12, #202020); font-weight: 600; } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--blue-9, #0090ff); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Badge
components.description: A tag or a date chip: soft fill, soft ink, 6 px corners. A passed deadline turns the text red on the same fill.
components.html: Nov 20 Due Nov 2 #work
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; padding: 1px 7px; border-radius: var(--radius-badge, 6px); background: var(--gray-3, #f0f0f0); color: var(--gray-11, #646464); font: 500 13px/20px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Text', 'PingFang SC', 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-badge svg { opacity: .8; } .ds-badge-warn { color: var(--red, #e5484d); }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: A field on the sign-in screen or in a sheet: white, a 1 px ring, 8 px corners, a blue focus ring in the app.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 6px; max-width: 360px; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Text', 'PingFang SC', 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field-label { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--gray-11, #646464); } .ds-input { height: 48px; padding: 0 14px; border: 0; border-radius: var(--radius-control, 8px); background: var(--gray-1, #ffffff); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--gray-7, #cecece); color: var(--gray-12, #202020); font: 400 17px/1.55 inherit; transition: box-shadow .12s ease; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--gray-8, #bbbbbb); } .ds-input:hover { box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--gray-8, #bbbbbb); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--blue-9, #0090ff); outline-offset: 2px; }

Days

components.css: .ds-block { display: grid; gap: 6px; max-width: 420px; padding: 14px 16px; border-radius: var(--radius-block, 12px); background: var(--gray-1, #ffffff); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--gray-5, #e0e0e0); color: var(--gray-12, #202020); font: 400 17px/1.55 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Text', 'PingFang SC', 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-block-head { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 8px; } .ds-block h2 { margin: 0; font-size: 17px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -.01em; } .ds-block p { margin: 0; } .ds-block-meta { font-size: 13px; color: var(--gray-11, #646464); }

components.name: Checkbox
components.description: The to-do's box: 20 px, 1.5 px grey edge, 5 px corners; checked fills Thread Blue with a white tick, one of the five places blue may appear.
components.css: .ds-task { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 10px; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 8px; border-radius: 8px; font: 400 17px/1.45 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Text', 'PingFang SC', 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--gray-12, #202020); cursor: pointer; } .ds-task:hover { background: var(--gray-2, #f9f9f9); } .ds-check { appearance: none; -webkit-appearance: none; flex: none; width: 20px; height: 20px; margin: 12px 0 0; border: 1.5px solid var(--gray-7, #cecece); border-radius: 5px; background: var(--gray-1, #ffffff); display: grid; place-content: center; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color .12s ease, border-color .12s ease; } .ds-check::after { content: ''; width: 10px; height: 6px; border: 2px solid #ffffff; border-top: 0; border-right: 0; transform: translateY(-1px) rotate(-45deg) scale(0); transition: transform .12s ease; } .ds-check:hover { border-color: var(--blue-9, #0090ff); } .ds-check:checked { background: var(--blue-9, #0090ff); border-color: var(--blue-9, #0090ff); } .ds-check:checked::after { transform: translateY(-1px) rotate(-45deg) scale(1); } .ds-check:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--blue-9, #0090ff); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-task-title { padding: 9px 0; } .ds-task-done .ds-task-title { color: var(--gray-9, #8d8d8d); text-decoration: line-through; text-decoration-color: var(--gray-7, #cecece); }

narrative.overview:
Daythread is a document before it is an interface. Every screen is a sheet of white paper; the words on it are the user's own, and everything the app adds is set in grey so that it reads as margin notes, not as chrome. Hierarchy comes from type weight and from which step of one neutral scale a thing is drawn in, never from a fill or a second colour. Edges are hairlines. Where a resting surface in most apps would be tinted, here it stays white and gets a 1 px line.

The system is quiet and precise. Quiet: nothing asks for attention unless it is the user's data or a warning that something is about to be lost; a selected tab, filter or sidebar row is a slightly darker grey, not a coloured block. Precise: rows align to the pixel across every row type on the page, markers centre on the first text line, and a geometry gate measures this at 390 and 1280 before a change is shown to anyone. The one colour, blue, is spent where attention is at this instant: the focus ring, the checked box, the text selection, the editor's chips, and the word Today. The mark tells the same story: three grey dots on a line, today the only one filled.

Controls are flat and typographic. A button is text in a bordered rounded rectangle; the primary action is the darkest grey with white text, and links are grey and underlined. Hover moves one step along the scale. Depth exists only for layers that genuinely float above the page.
keyCharacteristics: One white surface for every screen, including the sidebar; the first version's tinted grouped background is gone.
One 12-step neutral scale, Paper to Ink, carrying text, icons, borders, fills and every state.
Blue on a closed list of five uses; the primary button and links are grey.
8 px rounded rectangles with a 1 px border for controls; pills only on small badges and the phone's tab capsule.
Hairlines separate; fills never do. Shadows appear only under floating layers.
System type stack, 17 px body, hierarchy by weight and grey step.
Dark mode is the same twelve steps restated; no rule is special-cased per scheme.

rules.name: The One Blue Rule
rules.body: Blue appears in exactly five places: the focus ring, the checked box, text selection and the editor's chips, the word Today, and the written-day dot. Anything not on that list is grey, including the primary button, links, the selected tab, the selected filter and the sidebar's active row.

rules.name: The Grey Auth Rule
rules.body: The sign-in, sign-up, forgot and reset screens have no primary among many, so they have no blue at all: the button is Ink with Paper text, links are Ink-soft underlined, and the focus ring is Ink.

rules.name: The Step Rule
rules.body: A component names a step or an alias onto a step, never a raw value. Hover and pressed states move one or two steps along the scale in the same direction; they never change hue.

rules.name: The Weight Carries Rule
rules.body: A heading differs from a line by weight and size, not by colour: titles and body are Ink, secondary text is Ink-soft, tertiary is Ink-faint. Nothing is emphasised by being blue.

rules.name: The Quiet Copy Rule
rules.body: On-screen text states the user's data or state, or warns before something is lost. A line that explains how the app works is left out; menus show titles only. A new grey "explains why" line needs a reason.

rules.name: The Floating Rule
rules.body: A shadow means the layer is above the page. Nothing at rest casts one; a menu, sheet, capsule or dialog always does.

rules.name: The Hairline Rule
rules.body: An edge is a 1 px line in Hairline grey, not a tinted background. A block on a page, an empty state, a note card and the sidebar's edge all get the line; none gets a fill.

rules.name: The Rounded-Rectangle Rule
rules.body: A control is an 8 px rounded rectangle with a 1 px edge. A fully rounded control is a tab in the phone's capsule or nothing.

dos: Do name a token for every colour, size and radius; a raw hex, px font size or radius in a component rule is a review finding.
Do give an element an edge with a 1 px Hairline inset ring when it needs one, and leave the surface white.
Do keep blue to the five listed uses, and make every selected state a one-step-darker grey.
Do keep every tap target at 44 px on the phone and keep row actions visible on touch.
Do run the geometry gate at 1280 and 390 before showing a visual change, and honour reduced motion on every animation.
Do restate a new colour in the dark block only when it is off the two scales; otherwise name a step.
donts: Don't make a control a pill. Fully rounded shapes belong to the phone's tab capsule and small badges only; buttons, inputs and filters are 8 px rounded rectangles.
Don't introduce a second accent. No teal, green or violet in the product UI; red is for a passed deadline or a destructive action and nothing else.
Don't add text that explains how the app works. Helper lines, placeholder tutorials and second lines in menus are left out; text states data or state, or warns before a loss.
Don't fill a resting surface or cast a shadow under one; depth is for menus, sheets, capsules and dialogs.
Don't colour the primary button or links blue, on any screen.
